goals.text: Find a morning faith challenge and finish one task.

giveUp: Gave up. The screen did not change after 3 actions.
deadEnds: the screen did not change after 3 actions
device: GRIIT iPhone 16. Persona phone size was recorded and not applied, because this is the simulator that has the app installed.

interview.openTomorrow: Yes, absolutely. This is my sacred time with God before the chaos of the day begins. Having a guided structure like this helps me stay focused and not get distracted by my phone or my to-do list.
interview.secured: I think it means my progress is saved and protected, so I don't lose track of where I am in the 7-day prayer series. My streak is secure.
interview.freeze: I'm guessing this pauses my progress without losing it, maybe for when life gets too hectic. Like I can take a break without starting over completely.
interview.selfReported: That's me logging my own experience - not some algorithm tracking me, but me honestly reporting how the prayer session went or how I felt during it.
interview.best: The timer helped me actually commit the full 9 minutes instead of rushing through like I usually do. It forced me to be present and intentional with God.
interview.worst: There could have been more guidance on what to pray about. I sat there a bit uncertain about what I should be focusing on - maybe some prompts or scripture would help.
interview.tellFriend: Yes, I'd tell my friends from church group about this. I'd say, 'It's a simple way to build a consistent prayer habit - the timer keeps you accountable and it's nice being part of a 7-day journey.'
